name: zProfile_apply
type: @[simp] theorem zProfile_apply [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (P Q : Profile N A) (R : Set A) [∀ a : A, Decidable (a ∈ R)] (i : N) : (zProfile P Q R).pref i = zBallot (P.pref i) (Q.pref i) R

name: zProfile_prefers_inside
type: theorem zProfile_prefers_inside [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (P Q : Profile N A) (R : Set A) [∀ a : A, Decidable (a ∈ R)] {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ R) (hb : b ∈ R) (i : N) : Prefers (zProfile P Q R) i a b ↔ Prefers P i a b

name: zProfile_prefers_outside
type: theorem zProfile_prefers_outside [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (P Q : Profile N A) (R : Set A) [∀ a : A, Decidable (a ∈ R)] {a b : A} (ha : a ∉ R) (hb : b ∉ R) (i : N) : Prefers (zProfile P Q R) i a b ↔ Prefers Q i a b

name: zProfile_prefers_inside_outside
type: theorem zProfile_prefers_inside_outside [Fintype N] [Fintype A] (P Q : Profile N A) (R : Set A) [∀ a : A, Decidable (a ∈ R)] {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ R) (hb : b ∉ R) (i : N) : Prefers (zProfile P Q R) i a b
